payload.title: Native SDK parity: Swift/Kotlin projection subscribe + delta apply
payload.description: Follow-up after the gateway push lands (FR-109). Mirror the TS client's projection subscribe + ProjectionDelta apply in packages/swift and apps/android/frick so native clients can consume live projections too. Regenerate DTOs (pnpm schema:generate) if the frame surface needs it; keep cross-SDK parity per docs/cross-platform-client-contract.md.
